player_prompt.intro:
Malinacbay ka ed Lights Out! May {size}x{size} grid ka na ilay lights.
Say impanggoal mo et ontunen amin diad ILAY lights OFF (representado ed '.')
No ontunen ka ed ilay, ontunen to man din siamay adjacent neighbors (taas/baba/wanan/kaliwa).
Sulat [row col] a ontunen ed ilay (0-indexed, so baleg so ranggo 0-{max_index}).
May up to {max_turns} moves ka a solbayan diad puzzle.
Legend: 'O' = ilay ON, '.' = ilay OFF

board.current_state:
Kasalatan na estado na grid (Laras {moves_made}, {moves_left} laras natitipon, {completion}% nakompleto):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say action et nepeg ya format [row col] no say linya tan kolumn so integer manlapud 0 anggad {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Say koordinado ya dapat ya manlapo 0 ya {max_index}. In-enter mo ya [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Komendasyon! Asolusyonan mo so puzzle ed {moves_used} iran galaw!
